summary: Your report presents a coherent single-satellite coral-monitoring mission with STK screenshots and a quantified ground-station access table. The concept and Australian benefit are clear. To move from adequate to accomplished, strengthen launch/orbit justification, add operational and link/coverage analysis, provide software files, correct the EOL description, and improve referencing and figure/table formatting.
next_steps: For C2, add STK/PIGI files and supporting calculations: justify Vega E against alternatives and availability, derive the RAAN value, include link budget/data rate/swath/revisit analysis, and correct the EOL drag sail as a passive device rather than an orbital manoeuvre.
For C2, expand operations and coverage: describe power, thermal, attitude and detailed coverage planning, and quantify communication statistics beyond average contact duration.

For C3/C4, tighten conclusions to the evidence and improve presentation: number/caption all figures and tables consistently, replace Wikipedia with credible sources, format references with titles/authors, and revise informal language.

criteria.C1: You clearly explain the coral-reef monitoring mission, Australian benefit, need for fluid-lensing observation, single-spacecraft choice and likely users in the Introduction. To sustain the Accomplished standard, sharpen the distinction between operator and customer roles and ensure every claim is referenced.
criteria.C2: You address launch, orbit, ground station, duration and EOL with STK screenshots and an access table. To reach Accomplished, provide STK/PIGI files, justify Vega E and the 600 km orbit with alternatives and calculations (RAAN, link budget, data rate, swath/revisit), correct the passive drag-sail EOL description, and describe operations, power, thermal and attitude.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion draws specific launch, orbit and ground-station outcomes, but it is brief and somewhat generic and overstates how fully the configuration is described. For Accomplished, tie each conclusion explicitly to evidence in the main body, include key quantitative results and limitations, and avoid claims not supported by the design.
criteria.C4: Your report has headings, an executive summary and a bibliography, but presentation is not yet professional. For Accomplished, number and caption all figures/tables consistently (e.g. Image 1), replace Wikipedia with credible sources, format references with titles/authors, ensure in-text citations match the list, and revise informal language.
